findings.likely_impact: Higher heap pressure, more garbage collection, and reduced steady-state performance.
findings.recommended_remediation: Reuse mutable helpers where safe, pre-size collections, or move allocations outside the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Cutting temporary objects reduces bytes allocated and the CPU spent reclaiming them.

findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Rebuilding invariant helpers during each iteration spends CPU cycles and allocations on work that can usually be reused.
findings.likely_impact: Higher latency, avoidable GC churn, and lower throughput on larger collections.
findings.recommended_remediation: Hoist reusable helpers outside the loop and cache invariant computations.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Reusing expensive helpers reduces instructions executed and memory churn per item processed.
